name: RapidAPI Hub

sources.title: Add an API — Provider Dashboard > 'Add New API'; UI definition or OpenAPI upload; then overview page for description/website/terms/logo (content read via search result)
Getting started — rapidapi.com/studio or 'My APIs' in the Hub header; Hub Listing tab in Studio manages listing details (content read via search result)
Hub Listing — manage logo, category, descriptions, website, terms, visibility, tags, base URLs, health check; Monetize tab configures subscription plans (content read via search result)

requirements: Only relevant if the product IS or HAS a public API — this is an API marketplace, not a startup directory
A working API: either define it in the RapidAPI UI or upload an OpenAPI spec
Listing fields: logo, category, short + long description, website URL, terms of use, tags, base URLs
Visibility is set to public on the Hub Listing; consumers subscribe to a plan before use
Monetization is optional — plans (BASIC/PRO) can be free or paid
preparation: A live, documented HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec (preferred) or endpoints to define manually
Decide plan structure (free tier + paid tiers if monetizing)
workflow: Sign up at rapidapi.com and open Studio (rapidapi.com/studio) or 'My APIs'
Click 'Add New API' in the Provider Dashboard
Define the API via the UI or upload an OpenAPI file
Complete the Hub Listing tab: logo, category, descriptions, website, terms, tags, base URLs
Configure plans on the Monetize tab (even a free listing needs a plan consumers subscribe to)
Set visibility to public — the API then appears on the RapidAPI Hub
watchFor: Listing requires an actual API product — a SaaS without a public API cannot list
RapidAPI proxies calls — your API traffic flows through their gateway and they take a revenue share on paid plans
Every API needs at least one plan defined before consumers can subscribe
rapidapi.com returned an empty/JS-only response to plain fetch — details verified via docs.rapidapi.com
countsAsLive: The API appears publicly on the RapidAPI Hub at rapidapi.com/<org>/api/<api-name>
unknowns: RapidAPI's revenue-share percentage on paid plans — not confirmed this session
Whether there is any editorial review before a public listing goes live
